title: Labor and Parts fields at rest and on hover look as designed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and Labor reads {Sales-rep-A} and Parts reads {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • The design canvas is open in another tab at page 1, boards 1.9, 1.10, 1.12 and 1.13.
    For example: the canvas is https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Without hovering, compare the two fields with board 1.12.
  2. Hover over the rows and compare with board 1.10.
  3. Hover over the remove x and compare with board 1.13.
  4. Set the browser zoom to 200% and look at the two labels.
  5. Repeat steps 1 and 2 with the window 1536 px wide.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: "Sales Representative - Labor" above "Sales Representative - Parts", both labels in full, plain at rest, with 16 px between all fields.
  • Step 2: both fields show their box at once; each arrow sits in the bottom-right corner of its field, on the name line; the remove x (32 px, 20 px x icon, grey) sits beside Parts only; no button beside Labor; no +.
  • Step 3: the remove x shows a light fill and the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Parts".
  • Step 4: both labels still show in full, never cut off, and no arrow covers a label.
  • Step 5: the same look with nothing overlapping.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10890; story SV-11265 (Story 1, Give a work order its sales representative); story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative); PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 8 (14 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S1-R6, S1-R11, S2-R8, S2-R9, S2-R10, S2-R14, read 19 Oct 2026. Claude design canvas "Splitting Sales Representatives" (https://claude.ai/artifact/8MHqwyffAYtqZ6EccS5RUm), export read 19 Oct 2026, page 1, boards 1.9, 1.10, 1.12 and 1.13, used for the picture to compare against. Source-verified 19 October 2026. The build is not yet available to check this case against.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R6: “The vertical gap between Lead Technician, Service Advisor and every Sales Representative field on the card is 16px. This holds with one field, with the Labor and Parts fields (S2-R5), and on the read-only card (S2-R17).”
  • S1-R11: “The dropdown arrow sits at the right end of the field, vertically centered on the label and the name together, the same as on Lead Technician and Service Advisor. With the Labor and Parts fields showing (S2-R5), the arrow sits instead in the bottom-right corner of each field, on the name line, so it never covers the longer label on a narrow or zoomed screen.”
  • S2-R8: “A remove x sits to the right of "Sales Representative - Parts", in the column the + uses: the same Tertiary button, 32px square, showing the Lucide x icon at 20px, grey at rest with a light fill on hover.”
  • S2-R9: “Hovering the remove x shows the tooltip "Remove Sales Representative - Parts".”
  • S2-R10: “While the two fields show, the + is not shown, because there is nothing left to add. "Sales Representative - Labor" has no button beside it.”
  • S2-R14: “Both labels show in full on the card, never cut off.”
